name: SilverLining
summary: Funds and coordinates research on solar radiation modification (cooling the planet by reflecting sunlight) through its Safe Earth System Research Initiative, and works with governments and international bodies on research programmes and governance.

lines.label: Research grants and science, policy and stakeholder engagement on solar radiation modification (every programme)
lines.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/2025_TEOS_XML_11C.zip (Form 990 for 2024, Part III lines 4a-4e): policy $1,441,366; research and innovation (the Safe Earth System Research Initiative's grants) $1,883,807; stakeholder engagement $1,109,970; other programmes $889,390 (total $5,324,533).
